description: Digiroad provides Finland's national road and street centreline geometry and key network attributes. The provider is Fintraffic (current responsibility stated on Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency page). Geographical and temporal coverage: Digiroad began in 2004; the provider page identifies Fintraffic responsibility from 1 January 2026. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Individual releases and attribute completeness must be checked; no network payload was downloaded. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
